byte_interfaces.recipe: Native 32-byte SHA-256. No text encoding, framing, slicing, endian conversion or seed mask.
BLAKE2b digest_size=8; eight native bytes, not truncation of default-width BLAKE2b. Caller retains domain, u32LE group-byte-length frame, validation and <II unpacking.
BLAKE2b digest_size=16; 32 lowercase hex characters. Caller retains canonical_layer_config_json and UTF-8.

Ordered unframed concatenation, each update before acquiring the next chunk; no join, copy, coercion, accumulator exposure or IO ownership. Empty stream hashes empty bytes. Consumer owns exact transcript generator and refusal order. Not an interleaved guarded serializer sink API.
byte_interfaces.consumer_proof_boundary: Only target_values_sha256 transcript composition is exercised here, with explicit policy resolver stub. Full original scientific/attestation callers must supply their own independent tests before migration.

byte_interfaces.signature: Existing length_framed_bytes_sha256(items: Iterable[bytes], *, prefix: bytes = b"") -> str; decode only when original returns bytes
byte_interfaces.recipe: Domain followed by each ordered u64BE byte length and item. _framed retains its compact insertion-order Unicode tuple JSON and 32-byte result; roster retains separate domain, input order and hex result.

tensor_interfaces.recipe: detach/contiguous/flatten; element-aligned chunks of max(1,int(chunk_bytes)//max(element_size,1)); each .to("cpu").view(uint8).numpy() fed before next acquisition. Shape/dtype absent; 64 hex. Whole contiguous() may copy device storage. Scalar accepted after reshape.

as_tensor/detach; recursive C-order <=4M-element slices; CPU float32 contiguous -> numpy astype("<f4",copy=False).tobytes(order="C"); del cpu before next chunk. Return original shape then full64hex; not dtype-bit identity.

detach/to(cpu)/contiguous whole host copy; uint8 numpy memoryview.cast("B"), 8MiB byte-window feeds without a second full bytes allocation; empty bypasses cast; existing scalar uint8-view refusal preserved. Key order shape,dtype,logical_bytes,content_sha256.

existing_routes.contract: Exact existing raw-buffer / strict UTF-8 text full64 hex. Caller truncation remains local (allocator Pareto keeps [:12]); no new allocator profile needed.

Path-open/block-read versus caller-owned hashlib.file_digest are not interchangeable. Preserve descriptor position, chunk sizes, fences, guards, page release and acquisition; same hash is not proof of same read contract.
Existing named source framing only: u32BE names/u64BE contents versus legacy NUL framing. Preserve order/domain and v2 identity separation.
Existing explicit protocol4 canonical sharing recipe only. Do not replace highest-protocol pickle or shared probe/menu identity graphs; ordinary serializer memo sharing remains caller-owned.
Existing whole-host raw-bit recipes unchanged, including scalar uint8-view refusal. Not substitutes for new bounded/FP32 profiles.

incompatible_contracts.contract: All six original retentions remain authoritative. Source-identity revalidation belongs serial census integration.

Binary hash equality is owner recipe evidence, not authorization to alter seed domain, seed algorithm/endian/mask, sampling or scientific inputs. Leaf consumer must provide its current qualification witness.
Nested JSON/NUL/dtype/shape/tensor SHA reference remains independent; do not replace its oracle with production owner.
